title: UK Companies House Lookup & Monitor — your list of companies

companies.title: Company numbers or names
companies.description: One company per line: a Companies House number (e.g. 00000006, SC123456 — short numbers are zero-padded) or a company name (the best search match is used). Each company is one result.

mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: Look up — every company on the list
Monitor — only what changed since the previous run
mode.description: Monitor mode keeps the previous run's records as the baseline (in this actor's key-value store) and pushes a company only when it is new to the list, has changed (status, charges, accounts or confirmation-statement dates, filings, corporate PSCs — see changed_fields) or has disappeared from the register. Schedule it daily; unchanged companies cost nothing.

max_results.title: Maximum results
max_results.description: Stop after this many results (you are charged per result).
